user.title: Add a Gexis Player
user.description: The player's address on the home network, for example livingroom.local, and its port.

error.cannot_connect: The player did not answer at this address.
error.update_player: This player is too old for Home Assistant. Update it first: Settings → System → Software update on the player.

abort.update_player: This player is too old for Home Assistant. Update it first: Settings → System → Software update on the player.
abort.not_ipv4_address: Only players reached over IPv4 can be added.

show_page.name: Show a page on the screen
show_page.description: Puts a page of Home Assistant's on the player's screen for a while, over whatever it shows; the music plays on. A touch, a remote's key or its time takes it down. Needs Pages from Home Assistant switched on in the player's Settings → Display.

url.name: Address
url.description: The page's address, as the player's browser reaches Home Assistant (the dashboard's address shows how).

id.name: Name
id.description: A name for the page, so it can be taken down by name and seen on the Page sensor. 'page' if left empty.

seconds.name: For how long
seconds.description: Seconds it stays up, 10 to 3600; 600 if left empty.

hide_page.name: Hide the page
hide_page.description: Takes the page down, and the player's screen shows what it showed before.

id.name: Name
id.description: Only the page of this name; any page if left empty.

preload_page.name: Keep a page loaded
preload_page.description: Gives the player a page to keep loaded and hidden, so that Show a page on the screen with the same address shows it at once. Leave the address empty to stop keeping it. Needs Pages from Home Assistant switched on in the player's Settings → Display; the page has to stop its own video while hidden.

url.name: Address
url.description: The page's address, as for Show a page on the screen; empty to stop keeping one.
